  constructor
  intro n hn g
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_iInf, Subgroup.mem_comap] at hn ⊢
  intro i
  have hi : f n ∈ H i := hn i
  have heq : f (g * n * g⁻¹) = f g * f n * (f g)⁻¹ := by
    calc f (g * n * g⁻¹) = f (g * n) * f g⁻¹ := by rw [map_mul]
      _ = f g * f n * f g⁻¹ := by rw [map_mul]
      _ = f g * f n * (f g)⁻¹ := by rw [map_inv]
  rw [heq]
  apply (hH i).conj_mem
  exact hi
